name: Zenith Seizing Arrow
name_jp: 究極シージングアロー
effects:
Seven single-target Ice/Water/NE magic attacks, Lv.2 En-Ice or Lv.2 En-Water Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Ice/Water Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases an Ice/Water ability with Dualcast Ice/Water 4 to user (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Ice/Water, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Artemis Arrow+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Artemis Volley+: Chase after every use, Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
